commit.message:
feat(profile-url): normalize profile links and add dev mode skip (#372)

* feat(profile-url): normalize profile links and add dev mode skip

- Create useProfileUrl hook that resolves divine.video subdomain URLs
- Hook validates NIP-05 to determine if user has divine.video account
- Returns /profile/{npub} URL (normalized) with isSubdomain flag
- VideoCard and FullscreenVideoItem now use the hook instead of inline npub
- ProfilePage redirect skips in development mode (import.meta.env.DEV)
- Remove unused nip19 imports from VideoCard and FullscreenVideoItem

* fix(profile-url): remove useQuery dependency to fix test failures

The hook was calling useNip05Validation which uses useQuery from TanStack
React Query. Even with enabled=false, useQuery requires QueryClientProvider
to exist in the component tree. Tests don't wrap components in QueryClientProvider
so this caused "No QueryClient set" errors.

This changes the hook to use plain fetch with useState/useEffect instead of
useQuery, avoiding the React Query dependency entirely.

* fix(urlHook): adjust from code review

* fix(profile-url): remove useProfileUrl hook per review feedback

* fix(profile-url): reuse profile route helper

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix: prevent HubSpot tracking script from capturing native forms (#376)

The global HubSpot tracking script (hs-scripts.com) auto-captures
submissions from any <form> element as "Non-HubSpot Forms," creating
ghost contacts in the CRM. All four native forms in divine-web submit
to invite.divine.video or publish Nostr events -- none are intended
for HubSpot. Add data-hs-do-not-collect="true" to opt them out.

commit.message:
docs: overhaul contributor documentation and agent skills (#377)

* docs: add HUMAN_VS_MACHINE.md for AI agent acknowledgment

Adapted from minijinja's protocol. Requires AI agents to read
CONTRIBUTING.md and ARCHITECTURE.md, explain rules to the human
operator, and get confirmation before creating .ai-ack.

* docs: add ARCHITECTURE.md with tech stack, source layout, and patterns

Extracted from AGENTS.md. Covers entry point flow, state management,
routing, styling, build pipeline, key dependencies, linting, testing,
naming conventions, and external integrations. Includes local file
links for discoverability. Note at top: update when changing referenced
files.

* docs: rewrite CONTRIBUTING.md from divine-mobile template

Replaces the 4-line placeholder with a full contributor guide adapted
from divine-mobile. Covers contribution status (welcoming with
guardrails), good first contributions, templates and agent compliance,
technical debt standard, PR closure reasons, repo setup, architecture
expectations, product and design boundaries, testing expectations,
scope discipline, and PR requirements. Uses anchor links instead of
duplicating content within the document.

* docs: slim AGENTS.md, move skills to .agents/, symlink .claude/skills/

Slim AGENTS.md from 52 to 32 lines: removed coding style, testing,
PR conventions, and project structure sections (moved to skills).
Added AI acknowledgment check pointing to HUMAN_VS_MACHINE.md and
read-first section referencing CONTRIBUTING.md, ARCHITECTURE.md,
HUMAN_VS_MACHINE.md, and .agents/SKILLS.md.

Created .agents/ as the tool-agnostic canonical location for skills:
- .agents/SKILLS.md indexes all skills
- .agents/skills/coding-conventions/SKILL.md
- .agents/skills/testing-guidelines/SKILL.md
- .agents/skills/pr-conventions/SKILL.md
- .agents/skills/project-structure/SKILL.md
- .agents/skills/spa-subdomain-root-render/SKILL.md (migrated from
  .claude/skills/)

.claude/skills/ is now a symlink to ../../.agents/skills/ so Claude
Code finds skills at its expected path. .github/copilot-instructions.md
updated to point to AGENTS.md and .agents/SKILLS.md.
